_rtok_children() {
    case $1 in
        '') echo 'agents batch bench completions config docs doctor expand filter hook logs man plugins proxy report run stats task web wrap' ;;
        'agents') echo 'info install junk list uninstall update usage' ;;
        'agents junk') echo 'clear list' ;;
        'batch') echo 'fetch status submit' ;;
        'config') echo 'get init path set show validate' ;;
        'docs') echo 'fetch' ;;
        'logs') echo 'export watch' ;;
        'task') echo 'claim conflict create dep export init list next parallel priority ready release show status sync' ;;
    esac
}

_rtok() {
    local cur=${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]} cmd='' word i skip=0
    for ((i = 1; i < COMP_CWORD; i++)); do
        word=${COMP_WORDS[i]}
        if ((skip)); then
            skip=0
        elif [[ $word == -* ]]; then
            [[ " $(_rtok_values "$cmd") " == *" $word "* ]] && skip=1
        elif [[ " $(_rtok_children "$cmd") " == *" $word "* ]]; then
            cmd=${cmd:+$cmd }$word
        fi
    done
    if ((skip)); then
        COMPREPLY=()
    elif [[ $cur == -* ]]; then
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(_rtok_options "$cmd")" -- "$cur"))
    else
        COMPREPLY=($(compgen -W "$(_rtok_children "$cmd")" -- "$cur"))
    fi
}

complete -o default -F _rtok rtok
